          <p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Families with children are welcome! Please be mindful that we do try to keep a tranquil atmosphere and want to be considerate to all guests.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We require children to be over the age of 12 to swim with whales. Special exceptions can be made after a swimming test performed by the guides and at the sole discretion of the guides and management.</p><p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">If you have kids under the age of 12, you need to book all spaces on the boat for you and your family.</p>
        </div>

          <p data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Allan and Lyn Bowe motored into &nbsp;Tonga in 1992 and was drawn to the islands for their untouched beauty and a community rich in heritage and sharing. &nbsp; He found himself in awe of the environment and the huge Humpback Whales that migrate every year to the warm water of Vava'u and Tonga. He had the courage to jump in the water with the whales, so beginning a relationship he wanted to share with the world. He established the first Swim with the Whales business in 1993.</p><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">What started as wonder with these gentle giants grew into a deep passion for sharing their magic with the world.</p>
